title: homerun2-schedule-pitcher-profile chart
_comment: additionalProperties left open so the catalog verifier (call-argocd-verify-catalog) can inject its common probe values like `destination` without tripping the schema. The chart only consumes `name`, `content`, `serviceAccount` and `secretAccess`; anything else is ignored.

name.description: ConfigMap name. Must match schedulePitcher.profileConfigMap in apps/homerun2/install, which the Deployment patch mounts.

content.description: The SchedulePitcherProfile (profile.yaml) as a YAML string, passed through verbatim.

secretAccess.description: One Role + RoleBinding (get on exactly these Secrets) per namespace.
